trap.segment: Vegans and strict vegetarians: 72% purchase intent but only 1.3 million adults, 2.5% of adults 18-64
trap.target: Health-conscious office workers and Weekly sport practitioners

items.quote: Verdo Foods aims to scale internationally by entering the €480 million French protein snack market [1].
France is the second largest savoury snack market in Europe (€2.9 billion in 2024) and the fastest-growing market for protein snacks in Southern Europe [1].
The protein snack category stands at €480 million, growing at an impressive 11% per year [1].
Plant-based products represent 18% of this category [1].
Furthermore, 27% of French adults bought a protein snack in the last three months [1].
Supermarkets and hypermarkets dominate distribution (68%), followed by specialized sport and organic shops (17%), online channels (9%), and gyms/vending (6%) [1].

strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target (health-conscious office workers and weekly sport practitioners) follows from the segment figures: sport practitioners are the largest group (17.5M, 41% intent) and office workers have high intent (38%) with 9.0M adults, and the plan explicitly sets aside the vegan niche (1.3M, 2.5%) in line with the mission. The rationale for the 68% supermarket share and the channels is supported, but the pricing direction ("slightly above private labels, parallel to Gerblé") is not backed by any price comparison, which the document says has not been done, and the plan does not compare segments against the 1,500-point and 2% share goals.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Messages for POS, digital (office 4 PM cravings and post-workout recovery) and gyms/specialised shops speak to the chosen segments and the positioning of clean, Nutri-Score, 15g protein, and the channels match the strategy. One gap: the content ideas and visual direction are generic and the "Blind Taste Test" and Italian heritage content are not tied to a specific segment, and the gyms/specialised message is aimed at a plant-based profile rather than the office and sport target.
